reason: Checklist for the review: gate green, no new runtime dependency, layering respected, --json stdout unchanged, exit codes unchanged, and the code-review item that a new or edited workflow must actually be triggered once on GitHub.
Verify test/layering.test.ts still passes conceptually: verifyBundle and restoreBackup must not drag node:fs into cli/, and core must not import cli/ or api/.
Confirm the new pre-swap and post-swap failures map to the same exit code and render through the same typed-error path as the rest of the update flow.
Confirm the bump is a PATCH and that package.json and src/version.ts agree before the commit is called done.
Verify the commit message format and that the tree was green at commit time.
Verify the work landed on the right branch and that no tag or main push happened without explicit user instruction.
